reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which matches the evidence: the cited paragraphs (§6 documentation rights, §3(e) Client access to logs, §8(f) anti-spam technical measures) contain no audit, inspection, records-examination or usage-verification right running against the Customer.

AUDIT is a protective rule limiting Vendor audits of us; silence is at least as favourable as the preferred position, so proposing frequency/notice/cost parameters would gratuitously create a Vendor audit right. Treating this as compliant rather than 'missing' is the correct reading of the playbook (do not flag what benefits our party).

The failing deterministic 'audit frequency limited' check is a heuristic artefact of there being no audit clause to carry a frequency limit; the rationale explains this accurately and no unaddressed risk remains.
Rendered redline is byte-identical to the originals, consistent with a compliant finding retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
